ベルナル.evidence: Surname of ジ・エーデル・ベルナル (glossary: The Edel Bernal); Setsuko corrects Rand's clipped ジエー with 《ジ・エーデル》・ベルナル, so the ・ベルナル half stands alone (no bare token in the sheet).

kept_omissions: 688:t_1:5: 私には、もう救えない - object of 'save' never stated (the ??? voice); rendered 'them'
688:t_2:5/38: それを受け入れるんだ - addressee is the whole crew, rendered as a general 'you'
688:t_2:7/40: 身体は…！ - 'What about your body' keeps the source's unfinished question
uncertain: 688:t_3:22: Rand's ジエーのじいさん is a clipped mangling of ジ・エーデル; rendered 'Old man Jay-Ay' (invented sound-alike) so that Setsuko's correction reads; 2099_01 has ジエー・ベイベル jokes that may want a matching style
688:t_3:23: new token $$ベルナル$$ proposed for bare Bernal (not in the sheet alone)
688:t_3:21: speaker options keyword/pilot; picked pilot (a character speaking)
688:t_1:3-5: unnamed voice (pid_SCRIFI_Q) kept as ???; 天を貫く柱 written plainly as 'the pillar that pierces the heavens', not the $$天柱$$ token, because the Japanese does not use the word 天柱
688:t_3:12: やっぱり？ read as AG being caught out ('I thought so, huh?'); tone ambiguous
688:t_3:19: 美少女 rendered 'a beautiful girl' (Kouji's reaction to the AG casing, not a statement about AG's gender)
688:t_2:15: 竜馬が虚無を封じた時 - 虚無 as 'the void'
688:t_2:3-56: the choice-branch scene repeats (t_2:3-13 = t_2:36-46, t_2:29-35 = t_2:50-56); identical English used in both copies
